name: Fixed-Resolution Surface Rendering with View Bounds
aliases: Surface Rendering with Adaptive Voxel Sampling and View Bounds
definition: A surface rendering technique that samples a volume at a fixed resolution (2 mm) regardless of volume length, up to strict spatial bounds, to ensure consistent visual detail for medical review (e.g., detecting faces in whole-body scans).
summary: Fixed-Resolution Surface Rendering with View Bounds renders medical volumes as surfaces at a uniform 2 mm resolution within strict physical bounds, preventing coarse sampling artifacts in long scans.
